## 分诊定级 → `domain:spec` · `needs-user-decision` · p3 · tooling。摘 `finding`。

卡片是二手观察并明写「re-derive exact cast sites」。跑完了,**前提成立,而且两条路线不再对称** —— 这一点改变裁决。

## 一 · 消费者半边**全在 objectui**,objectstack 零命中

```
objectstack:  gridClassName 非测试命中 = 0        className + `as any` 命中 = 0
objectui   :  packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:293/294 · 317/318 · 351/352 · 384 · 415/416
              packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:1285
              packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx:598
              —— 形如  className: (s as any).className,  gridClassName: (s as any).gridClassName,
```

⇒ 「退役读取」这条路的落点是 **`repo:objectui` 的 `plugin-form`**;「补声明」那条的落点是 `packages/spec`。本卡挂 `domain:spec`,因为**要裁的是边界本身**(这两个键该不该在可创作面上),而边界的所有者是 spec 席;若裁定「退役读取」,执行走跨座位路径交 objectui。

## 二 · 不声明是**有意的**,不是遗漏 —— 源码里就写着

```
packages/spec/authorable-surface.base.json:7592   "ui/PageComponent:className"     ← 台账里唯一的 className
packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json:907      同上
                                                   form-view / section 家族:零条

packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:1350
    * Deliberately NOT declared, per the file conventions: `className` on the …
```

⇒ spec 侧是**刻意**把这两个键留在 SDUI-only 侧的,而 objectui 的渲染器照读不误。卡片说的「声明在一边、跨越在另一边」属实。

⚠️ 而 objectui 的 CHANGELOG 显示消费者侧同样是**刻意**的:*"Section `className`/`gridClassName` now flow through JSON schemas … closing a gap where section wrappers couldn't be customized from schema"* —— 两侧各自有意,方向相反。这不是谁忘了,是**两个仓对同一条边界的理解从未对齐**。

## 三 · ⭐ 决定性读数:两条路线**不对称**,卡片把它们写成对称是不准的

`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts:606` 与 `:650` 记着一条已裁定的事实(ADR-0065,ADR-0080 2026-06-30 修订):

> `source` is **runtime metadata the build-time Tailwind never scans**, so utility classNames **silently produce no CSS**. Do not author Tailwind classes in page source in either tier.

⇒ **「补声明」意味着把一个键放上可创作面,而它最显而易见的用法(Tailwind 工具类)静默无效。** 那正是本仓反复在消灭的形状 —— 一个看起来能用、实际什么都不做的创作面。台账里唯一那条 `ui/PageComponent:className` 也带着同一条警告。

⇒ 我的读数是:**「退役读取」明显强于「补声明」**,除非你判定要把 `className` 作为**非 Tailwind**(设计令牌 / 宿主自有类)的正字通道并同批把这条限制写进文档。⛔ 但我不代裁 —— 退役读取会让**今天真的在 schema 里写了 `className` 的 SDUI 作者当场失去它**,那是一个面向已有用户的破坏性变更,属人工地板。

## 需要你答的那一句

> `className` / `gridClassName` 在 form-view / section 家族上:**(a)** 退役渲染器的读取(承认边界,接受破坏今天在用的 SDUI 作者),还是 **(b)** 补进可创作面(接受它对 Tailwind 类静默无效、须同批文档化),还是 **(c)** 维持现状并把「SDUI-only 但渲染器会读」写成明文约定?

**定级 p3**:今天无缺陷、无错误答案 —— 写了的人拿得到效果,没写的人不受影响。危害是**边界的可信度**:台账说「不可创作」,渲染器说「我读」,两者都不假,但一起看就没有一个可依赖的答案。

**Refs**:#13622(测量来源)· `packages/spec/authorable-surface/`(台账)· ADR-0065 / ADR-0080 修订(Tailwind 静默无效)。

## ⚖️ RULED — maintainer, 2026-09-01, director decision batch C, verbatim 「同意」: **retire the reads**

The renderers stop consuming `className` / `gridClassName` off the form-view family through `as any` casts — the authorable boundary (which deliberately excludes free-style keys from AI-authorable metadata) is the declaration of record, and the casts that cross it are removed. Declaring the keys was weighed and not adopted: it would formally invite free Tailwind strings into authored metadata, the exact class the boundary exists to keep out. If per-view styling ever becomes a real product need, it gets an explicit design (a controlled token surface), not two leaked keys.

**Enforce-or-remove order of operations**: ① census first — measure actual usage of the two keys in published/authored metadata (this repo's corpus + hotcrm, publicly readable); heavy usage is evidence back to this card before any narrowing ships. ② retire the cast reads + pin the non-consumption. ③ the removal is a behaviour narrowing for anyone who used the keys — changeset per the launch-window convention, ADR-0087 disposition if any declared surface moves.

State transition in this same pass: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. `domain:spec` lane (the authorable-boundary ledger is its face); exact cast sites re-derived at dispatch per the card's own re-check commands.

Executing the 2026-09-01 batch-C ruling (comment 5486946830, verbatim scope): ① **census first** — actual usage of `className`/`gridClassName` on the form-view family in authored metadata across the objectstack corpus, the objectui corpus, and hotcrm (read-only clone; heavy usage = evidence back to this card BEFORE any narrowing ships); ② retire the `as any` cast reads (`ObjectForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx` sites per triage comment 5479541316, re-derived at dispatch) + pin the non-consumption; ③ changeset per launch-window convention; no declared surface moves (the keys were never on the ledger), so no ADR-0087 disposition expected — the gate rules. `Clause-②: no` (no contract-schema accept/reject change; path limb not hit — objectui repo). Declared file surface: `objectui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`, `DrawerForm.tsx`, a non-consumption pin test, changeset; objectstack side read-only.

## Collection review: ACCEPT (no Clause-② carrier — `Clause-②: no` confirmed: no contract-schema accept/reject change, code lands in objectui)

Reviewed objectui PR [objectstack-ai/objectui#7198](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/7198) (5 files +354/−12) against the 2026-09-01 batch-C ruling:

1. **Census first, as ordered** — ZERO authored uses of `className`/`gridClassName` on form-view section nodes across all three corpora (objectstack `a7002ce5`, objectui `899730e`, hotcrm `a6be39a`; method and positive controls in the dev report 5492799425), so the narrowing shipped instead of returning evidence here.
2. **All seven cast reads retired** (six in `ObjectForm.tsx` — tabbed/wizard/split/drawer/modal maps + stacked divider — one in `DrawerForm.tsx`), each replaced by a deliberate-omission marker carrying the ruling and the ADR-0065/0080 rationale in place. Verified from hunks: no schema edit, no `packages/types` edit, form-root `className` (a different key, no cast) untouched — scope held at the ruled boundary.
3. **Non-consumption pinned behaviourally** (8/8 arms), with reverse verification (one predicted row red on cast restore, restore leg proven clean). The behavioural-not-grep choice is correct and forced: `ObjectFormSection` still declares both keys, so a cast-free re-read would type-check — that inert declared mirror is now recorded as objectui#7200 (finding, unassigned, first-touch grading is triage's).
4. Changeset minor declaring the narrowing; README repaired; plugin-form suite 81 files / 821 passed at merged head `4174960`; objectui governed-queue-guard reading: NOT GOVERNED.

Card #13626 stays open until the PR merges (Part-of, not Fixes — per the cross-repo close discipline); this seat closes and reconciles it at MERGED. Proceeding: ready → auto-merge on objectui#7198.
